verdict.rationale: PII redaction is a fair question for a scraping and content-extraction service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic PII detection or filtering. The generic x-json-schema and x-instruction extraction headers are adjacent building blocks at most, not a PII-filtering capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically detect and filter personally identifiable information out of scraped content before it reaches storage
